text:
Keiko (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — consolidating 3 common asks: promo windows, off-cycle process, and retro pay timing. short answers below.

Ravi (Head of Eng): thanks. managers need exact cutoffs to share in 1:1s.

Tara (Manager): also: can orgs request exceptions for high-performer hires?

Keiko (People Ops): timelines: self-reviews close 2026-06-06 EOD PT; manager review 2026-06-08 -> 2026-06-14; calibration meetings 2026-06-15 -> 2026-06-18; appeals window 2026-06-19 -> 2026-06-25.

Ben (Finance): off-cycle raises/promo rules: permitted for retention or scope change. submit the adjustment form (intra link), require Manager + Director signoff; >5% comp change needs Finance signoff. try to limit off-cycle cases to under 5% of org headcount.

Keiko (People Ops): new hires: generally wait one full cycle unless EM documents exceptional ramp, then use the hire-exception flow and tag Recruiting + People Ops.

Tara (Manager): retro pay if approved late?

HRRemindersBot: Retro-pay processed on next payroll after approval; expect 1-2 pay cycles delay.

Keiko (People Ops): we'll post a one-page cheatsheet and a manager justification template in #people-ops-resources within the hour. office hours tomorrow 15:00 PT for sensitive cases. DM me to book a slot. :white_check_mark:
